quotes.author: Patrick Hendrickson
quotes.text: The wife and I had an amazing time!! Could not ask for more, super professional, excellent safety knowledge and they made it seem like it was the easiest thing in the world, meanwhile the wife and I were 800ft up flying over Newport and the crew was handling things like a boss. Not a care in the world while flying , landing was super easy and they made the entire experience flawless. Can not say enough good stuff about them, 1000% get the photo package too!! 😁😁😁 next time we’re doing 1000ft!!!

quotes.author: Allison
quotes.text: Captain Kevin and Andrew were amazing!!! My friends are I went today and had a BLAST. We got the photo package and they all came out amazing! A Christmas card is on the way! The Crew was so friendly and helpful. We felt so safe and the views were incredible. We did the 1000 foot line and would definitely recommend!! Can't wait to come back.

quotes.author: Mssilka
quotes.text: My first time parasailing and it was an awesome experience! Island Style Parasail was wonderful from beginning to end. The customer service was great. They were well organized and prompt. I would definitely recommend!! Thank you for the awesome experience.

quotes.author: Nmpennin
quotes.text: The guys were awesome! My family had a fabulous time! My boys thought it was the coolest thing. And the dip we got was extraordinary! If you’re on the fence about booking this, I say do it! It was so peaceful and beautiful flying by the bridge!

WE HAD AN AWESOME TIME TODAY. JAMAL AND ALEX WERE GREAT!!! They explained everything we needed to know. The boat ride was great and parasail was fantastic. I recommend Island Style Parasail when visiting Newport.

quotes.author: Chris Stilman
quotes.text: Great time. Super impressed with Captain and his crewman. Couldn’t help but snore hope efficient the operation was. The actual experience on the church was very relaxing and fun. Nothing to be nervous about!
